# PackMojo

> PackMojo provides custom packaging for brands of all sizes, with 40+ product types (e.g. mailer boxes, folding cartons, rigid boxes, inserts), low MOQs starting at 100 units, sustainable materials (≥50% recycled, soy inks, optional FSC™-certified), and a streamlined platform for instant quotes, samples, and order management.

PackMojo's platform (app.packmojo.com) enables instant pricing, dieline access, artwork submission, and tracking for samples and production. Standard production is 12–16 business days after payment and artwork approval (longer for high volume). Shipping options include air and ocean, with DDP/DPU terms available. 

Key differentiators:
* Simplified packaging process: No packaging expertise required—PackMojo handles supplier management, logistics, and optimization to ensure customers get the highest quality packaging for their products
* Low MOQs (100–500+ depending on product)
* Sustainable by default; FSC™-certified option (FSC™-C198591)
* Robust, reimbursable sample program
* Flexible shipping (air/ocean, split shipments, multiple destinations)

## Product Categories

* [Mailer Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/mailer-boxes/): Corrugated shipping boxes with styles including standard, no dust flaps, no flaps, and with adhesive. MOQ 100 units.
* [Folding Carton Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/folding-carton-boxes/): Paperboard product boxes including reverse tuck end, straight tuck end, snap lock, auto bottom. MOQ 100–300 units.
* [Rigid Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/rigid-boxes/): Premium chipboard boxes (full cover lid, partial cover lid, shoulder & neck). MOQ 300 units.
* [Rigid Drawer Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/rigid-drawer-boxes/): Tray + sleeve with ribbon pull or thumb notch. MOQ 300 units.
* [Magnetic Rigid Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Hinged magnetic closure (non-collapsible and collapsible). MOQ 300 units.
* [Tray & Sleeve Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/tray-and-sleeve-boxes/): Foldable tray and sleeve boxes with thin or thick walls. MOQ 300 units.
* [Foldable Lid & Base Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/foldable-lid-and-base-boxes/): Two-piece foldable lid/base alternative to rigid boxes. MOQ 300 units.
* [Packaging Sleeves](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/packaging-sleeves/): Pre-glued sleeves, sleeves with adhesive, and flat sleeves. MOQ 500 units.
* [Custom Box Inserts](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/custom-box-inserts/): Cardboard inserts for holding products securely inside packaging.
* [Custom Foam Inserts](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/custom-foam-inserts/): Foam inserts for additional product protection and presentation.
* [Molded Pulp Inserts](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/molded-pulp-inserts/): Molded pulp insert options for protective and sustainable packaging.
* [Display Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/display-boxes/): Display boxes with or without dust flaps; machine-packed options available.
* [Cardboard Tubes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/cardboard-tubes/): Premium round packaging. MOQ 1,000 units.
* [Paper Bags](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/paper-bags/): Paper bags with ribbon, rope, or twisted handles. MOQ 500–2,000 units.
* [Custom Pouches](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/custom-pouches/): Resealable stand-up and flat pouches, including food-grade options. MOQ 300 units.
* [Custom Stickers](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/custom-stickers/): Custom stickers and labels for branded packaging.
* [Tissue Paper](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/tissue-paper/): Custom tissue paper for branded wrapping and inserts.
* [Hang Tags](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/hang-tags/): Custom hang tags for retail and product packaging.
* [Playing Cards](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/custom-playing-cards/): Custom printed playing cards.
* [Cake Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/cake-boxes/): Specialty cake packaging.
* [Pillow Boxes](https://packmojo.com/custom-packaging/pillow-boxes/): Specialty pillow-shaped boxes.

## Platform & Ordering

* [PackMojo Platform](https://packmojo.com/platform/): Configure specs, compare multi-quantity quotes, choose shipping (air/ocean; split shipments), download dielines, upload artwork, and track orders.
* [Dieline Templates](https://packmojo.com/packaging-dielines/): Standard templates available; custom dielines provided after a paid sample or production order.
* [PackMojo App](https://app.packmojo.com/): Authenticated platform for quotes, payment, order tracking, and product data. Quotes require 100% prepayment before production, with other payment options available for repeat customers.

## Samples

Get custom samples to test size, structure, artwork, and finishes. Many samples are reimbursable when ordering at least 500 units (see sample pages for specifics).

* [Samples Overview](https://packmojo.com/samples/): Overview of custom sample options.
* [Sample Kit](https://packmojo.com/samples/sample-kit/): Curated selection including a mailer, folding carton, rigid boxes, sleeve, insert, and swatches; reimbursable on a first production order.
* [Structural Sample](https://packmojo.com/samples/structural-sample/): Blank or unprinted sample to validate size and structure; available for most products.
* [Simplified Sample](https://packmojo.com/samples/simplified-sample/): Low-fidelity CMYK print to visualize artwork on packaging; excludes finishes/add-ons and is not available for rigid boxes.
* [Pre-Production Sample](https://packmojo.com/samples/pre-production-sample/): Full-spec 1:1 production sample including print, finishes, and add-ons; ideal for final validation.
* [Print Proof](https://packmojo.com/samples/digital-print-proof/): 2D CMYK proof on proof paper to check color and artwork alignment.
* [Press Proof](https://packmojo.com/samples/press-proof/): 2D proof on the production press and material for exact colors with finishes and add-ons.
* [Pantone Color Chip](https://packmojo.com/samples/pantone-color-chip/): Physical Pantone color reference.

## Services

Engineering and consultation to ensure optimal protection, presentation, and efficiency.

* [Structural Design Service](https://packmojo.com/services/structural-design/): Insert and complex structure design by packaging engineers; Essential and Premium packages include reimbursable amounts, structural samples, and proofs per tier.
